Conflicts.Title: Conflicts
Conflicts.SampleDataNotice: Sample data: these conflicts are examples, not your files.
Conflicts.Empty: No conflicts. Nothing needs your decision.
Conflicts.NoDetail: Select a conflict to compare its versions.
Conflicts.Reason.BothModified: The file changed on this computer and in OneDrive since the last sync, so CloudSync cannot tell which change to keep.
Conflicts.Reason.DeletedLocallyModifiedR: The file was deleted on this computer but changed in OneDrive, so CloudSync cannot tell whether to delete it or keep the change.
Conflicts.Reason.DeletedRemotelyModified: The file was deleted in OneDrive but changed on this computer, so CloudSync cannot tell whether to delete it or keep the change.
Conflicts.ActionsUnavailable: Resolving is not available yet: the sync service does not support it. These buttons will work once it does.
Conflicts.Recovery: Recovery available: resolving never deletes the other version straight away, so you can undo a wrong choice.
Conflicts.Confirm: Apply "{action}" to {count} conflict(s)? The other version stays recoverable.
